executiveSummary: High-impact financial and national-security incidents dominated the period. Coinbase reported blocking approximately $4.7 million in attempted transfers tied to a convincing Elon Musk deepfake livestream, underscoring how real-time, event-driven deception can scale rapidly at global audience levels. View Article U.S. federal prosecutors also charged suspects in a sprawling AI voice and image impersonation scheme that allegedly stole about $129 million from companies across sectors, highlighting persistent enterprise exposure to executive-impersonation fraud. View Article Nation-state-linked influence activity remained a priority focus. The EU sanctioned actors tied to a coordinated operation cloning news sites and impersonating journalists, while a major platform reported disrupting AI-enabled false-front operations using fabricated personas, fake documents, and scripted audio for geopolitical messaging. View Article Source Election-related risks intensified with federal and state-level alerts. The FBI and CISA warned that deepfake video and audio are being used alongside phishing and smishing targeting election and campaign officials, and IC3 flagged election-themed scams using AI-generated voices, images, and messages. Security Advisory Security Advisory Attorneys general in Michigan and New York separately warned voters about AI-generated election misinformation and deceptive chatbot guidance. Source View Article Public safety and consumer protection concerns persisted. Authorities reported widespread AI-enabled investment endorsement scams in the UK, while a fabricated video referencing a former U.S. president fueled misinformation around a FEMA alert test in Spanish-speaking communities. Source View Article Defensive and legal developments included a NIST benchmark for watermark robustness and platform guidance on content provenance checks (C2PA, SynthID). Supporting Report Source Overall, the threat environment appears to be worsening given the number of high-urgency incidents, official warnings, and active large-scale scams despite some successful defensive interventions. Organizations: Enforce dual-control for payments; require out-of-band callbacks to verified numbers; deploy AI voice anti-spoofing and anomaly detection on vendor/bank detail changes. (Analyst Recommendation)
News & Public-Safety Orgs: Implement rapid pre-bunking and multilingual rebuttals for emergency-alert narratives; verify contributor identities with C2PA where available. (Analyst Recommendation)
Legal & Policy: Update consent and likeness-use policies for synthetic media; preserve chain-of-custody for AI-generated abuse materials to meet evidentiary standards. (Analyst Recommendation)
